structural_change: hnx_xs4 = d4g ot_hbm_accel_smh_xs (p45m recipe: region pins, M4 H-face pins, M6 cap) with P=4 lane copies of the 4 x 128x256 macros (16 macros, 4 x 4 grid, lane p = row p), per-lane kept macro pin registers, per-lane x operand register (o_ix 4 x 788), lane write mask wl[3:0] riding the write pipeline; shared landing / strap tree / rotation / o_iw. Outline 501.12 x 289.44 (d4g xs 302.4 x 155.544, macro pitch kept 116.424 x 62.64). FACE SPLIT 10-19 (SM4 (a) tile layout): N = block-dot operands (o_iwb + o_ixb x P, 2,660 b, to the 4 bdc above), W / E = BF16 operands (shared weight copy per face, kept duplicate i-stage registers on W, + lanes 0-1 W / 2-3 E, 768 b per face, to the tcl stacks beside the store); S = landing inputs unchanged. CLOCK FIX 10-19 (SM4B): xs4 r3 gate pin-flop spread TT 93.5 / FF 86.0 > 80 with one root. Measured per face (TT, 4_1_cts): N 524-591, S 523-596, W 530-555, E 552-616 ps; all-register arrival 501-666 with every leaf net <= 6 ps internal -> the spread is H-tree level imbalance (E-face pin regs late vs the symmetric W face), not distance (0.50 x 0.29 mm tile, < the ~1 mm region-tree threshold). Variant xs4c1: obstruction-unaware H-tree (no detours around the 4x4 SRAM grid; s81 gather leaf precedent).
